route.reason: young ethereal ancient-fantasy assets prioritize beauty, youth and spirit over maximal facial photorealism
route.rule: route by character and output intent; user-explicit face mode always overrides automatic routing.

face_mode.label: Beauty-First Face
face_mode.goal: preserve youthful attractiveness, elegance and character appeal before increasing facial realism
prompt_translation: Preserve a youthful, elegant and beautiful face as the highest facial priority.
Keep soft cheek tissue, a refined oval facial read and clear youthful eyes; do not age the character up in order to make the face more realistic.
Use only light facial realism: delicate skin response, natural lips and brows, restrained eye definition and soft youthful facial volume.
Put stronger realism into hair, body, hands, costume materials and lighting rather than forcing the face toward a mature fashion-model look.
face_mode.principle: face direction is style-dependent; beauty, age impression and identity can take priority over maximum facial photorealism.

prompt_translation: Keep the visual age in the youthful 18–22 range.
Do not create mature fatigue, hollow cheeks, deep eye sockets, heavy under-eye darkness or a stern older fashion-model impression.
Preserve youthful cheek softness and clear facial energy while allowing only subtle natural skin realism.
maturity_guard.principle: maturity guard limits unwanted age drift; it does not force childishness.

realism_scope.rule: never infer that high non-face realism requires high face realism.

round_plan.prompt_strategy: face-mode-only calibration: protect identity and age impression, tune beauty/realism direction without changing body, costume or composition

prompt_skeleton: Keep approved face mode beauty_first, identity geometry and age impression unchanged.
Apply high realism to hair, body presence, hands, costume materials, cloth physics, footwear, lighting and camera response.
Do not increase facial maturity or facial realism just because non-face realism is high.
stage_2.note: Use this round when the face is already aesthetically approved but materials/body/camera still look CG.

rule: Choose the right face mode first; then improve non-face realism without reopening face maturity.
